gloss: thank you for your hard work (to a subordinate)

definitions.gloss: thank you for your hard work; good job
definitions.explanation: An expression used to acknowledge someone's effort or labor. Importantly, it is typically used by a superior toward a subordinate or by someone receiving a service. Using it toward a social superior is considered rude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「ご{苦労様|くろうさま}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I said "thanks for your work" to the delivery person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「ご{苦労様|くろうさま}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The department head said "good work" to the employees who worked overtime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作業員|さぎょういん}→作業員：24136_sagyouin⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「ご{苦労様|くろうさま}です」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ねぎらい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: In the heat, I offered words of appreciation to the construction workers, saying "Thank you for your hard work."

notes:
USAGE:
This expression is used to thank someone for their labor or effort, but it carries a hierarchical nuance. It is appropriate in the following situations:
- A boss to employees
- A customer to service workers (delivery, repair, etc.)
- A host to workers at their house

WATCH OUT:
Using ご{苦労様|くろうさま} toward a boss or social superior is widely considered rude, as it implies you are looking down on their effort. Use ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧です instead when speaking to peers or superiors.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ご{苦労様|くろうさま} vs. ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧: ⟦お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧ is safe to use with anyone regardless of hierarchy. ご{苦労様|くろうさま} should only be used toward subordinates or people providing a service to you.

FORMS:
- ご{苦労様|くろうさま}です (polite)
- ご{苦労様|くろうさま}でした (acknowledging completed work)
- ご⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧さん (casual, more familiar)
